verdict.rationale: Square's SDKs support explicit API versioning (date-based version strings that can be overridden per call, and SQUARE_VERSION pinning in the MCP server), showing a versioned API design, but the evidence pack contains no documented deprecation policy (e.g., sunset timelines, migration guides, EOL notices) for older API versions. missing for 10: explicit deprecation/EOL policy documentation, migration guides between versions, changelog of breaking changes.
